scope: Prospective complex two-Issue shared currency-contract comparison, not general performance or v0.4 comparison

baseline.skillOrigin: Frozen alpha.21 entrypoint, with common current reference files and runtime

earlyStop: Stop on execution or quality failure; after two complete pairs stop if candidate median time and tokens are both no better. Preserve all attempts.
acceptance: All six inner and outer oracles; independent submitted-HEAD review; both Draft PR workflows; complete parent and descendant usage; both medians lower and neither maximum worse. No evaluator implementation or planning.
comparisonLimits: Estimates effect of the accumulated entrypoint changes with common current runtime/reference assets. Does not compare complete historical releases. Prior observations not pooled.
status: stopped after first baseline evaluator failure; no replacement trials
